body.p: Please amend the claims as follows:

br.br:
1. (Currently amended) A sticking component comprising:
a sheet-shaped adhesive component having first and second sticking surfaces with adhesiveness opposed to each other, the first sticking surface constructed to be removably adhered to a bottom surface of a stick-on biometric device;
a first release layer[[component]] removably adhered to the first sticking surface of the sheet-shaped adhesive component sticking component; and
a second release layer [[component]] removably adhered to the second sticking surface of the sheet-shaped adhesive component sticking component,
wherein at least one of the first release layer [[component]] or the second release layer [[component]] has an outline that is visible, and that, when the sheet-shaped adhesive component sticking component is to be adhered to the stick-on biometric device, at least partially overlaps an outline of the bottom surface of the stick-on biometric device in a plan view of the sticking component, and
wherein the first release layer includes at least one region that is defined by a slit, and that, upon removal of the first release layer, the at least one region remains on the first sticking surface of the adhesive component, the slit being a closed slit and not in contact with an outer perimeter of the first release layer.
2. (Currently amended) The sticking component according to Claim 1, wherein at least one of the first release layer [[component]] or the second release layer [[component]] is made of an opaque material or a colored transparent material.
3. (Currently amended) The sticking component according to Claim 1, wherein at least one of the first release layer [[component]] or the second release layer [[component]] has an outline that, when the sheet-shaped adhesive component sticking component is to be adhered to the stick- on biometric device, overlaps the outline of the bottom surface of the stick-on biometric device in the plan view in respective straight sections of at least two sides of the bottom surface.
4. (Currently amended) The sticking component according to The sticking component according to
wherein the first release layer [[component]] has an outline that is visible, and that, when the sheet-shaped adhesive component sticking component is to be adhered to the stick-on biometric device, at least partially overlaps the outline of the bottom surface of the stick-on biometric device in the plan view, and
wherein the second release layer [[component]] is made of a colorless transparent material, and has an outline that is at least partially larger than an outline of the adhesive component.
5. (Currently amended) The sticking component according to Claim 1, wherein the first release layer [[component]] is divided by a cut line into a plurality of portions.
6. (Currently amended) The sticking component according to Claim 1, wherein the adhesive component includes a core made of a resin film, and respective adhesive layers disposed on opposite sides each side of the core.
7. (Currently amended) The sticking component according to Claim 1, wherein the second release layer [[component]] is divided by a perforation, a cuthalf-cut, or a fold into a plurality of portions.
8. (Currently amended) The sticking component according to Claim 1, wherein a release strip is sandwiched partially between the first sticking surface of the adhesive component and the first release layer [[component]], the release strip being non-adhesive and film-shaped.
9. (Original) The sticking component according to Claim 8, wherein the release strip is colored and transparent, or is opaque.
